pages.title: Bubble Clicker
pages.creator: Chow Studios
pages.description: Pop drifting bubbles to earn money in Bubble Clicker. Buy upgrades and hire Auto Poppers to earn while you’re away, then unlock bigger targets, from planets to black holes. Chain pops to trigger a Frenzy, and use prestige to start over with permanent boosts.

pages.title: Abyss Muncher
pages.creator: Rick&Jean
pages.description: Eat smaller creatures and steer clear of predators in Abyss Muncher. Explore changing underwater maps and build up your creature with mutations, skills, and relics. Use the rewards from each dive to unlock creatures and buy permanent upgrades for the next run.

pages.title: Mystic Word Quests
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Find the hidden words in Mystic Word Quests. Scan the grid for the first few letters of a word, then follow the sequence and select it when it matches. Find all the words on one board to move on to a trickier layout.

pages.title: Candy Crunch: Sugar Escape
pages.creator: BlinkStudio
pages.description: Slide candy blocks toward their matching exits in Candy Crunch: Sugar Escape. The pieces start packed tightly together, so work out which ones can move first to give the others room. New obstacles change the order you’ll need to use as you progress.

pages.title: 2 Player Battle
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Choose from 30 minigames in 2 Player Battle. Bring one to three other players and take turns trying the different contests. Switch games when you want a new challenge and see who comes out ahead when the rules change.

pages.title: Mojicon Winter Connect
pages.creator: 2Million Games
pages.description: Connect matching holiday tiles in Mojicon Winter Connect. Look for a route between reindeer, gingerbread men, and other pairs while working around the Ice Sheets. Clear the blockers to reach more tiles, then use the space you’ve opened to finish the board.

pages.title: Brainrot Hole
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Steer a hole around the map in Brainrot Hole. Swallow objects in its path and work toward defeating the Brainrot enemies. Later levels put more obstacles between you and the items you need, so find a route through the area before committing to a turn.

pages.title: Press "A" to Party
pages.creator: Boombit S.A.
pages.description: Share a screen with up to three other players in Press "A" to Party. Each arcade challenge uses a single button, so focus on when to press it as the action changes. Try the different minigames and see who gets the timing right most often.

pages.title: Stickman Guys Defense
pages.creator: Caner
pages.description: Defend your base from waves in Stickman Guys Defense. Position archers and sword fighters where they can reach incoming enemies, and upgrade their abilities as the attacks grow stronger. Look at how each wave gets through and decide where to reinforce your defense.

pages.title: Impostor Among Space
pages.creator: Breymantech
pages.description: Sneak through a spaceship in Impostor Among Space. Find opportunities to eliminate computer-controlled crewmates one at a time and sabotage systems to help cover your moves. Watch who’s nearby before you act so you can finish the mission without being spotted.

pages.title: Superwings ColorSwitch
pages.creator: Tap Tap Tales
pages.description: Guide Golden Boy through space in Superwings ColorSwitch. Watch the gaps in circles, barriers, and boxes before you move into them. Time each pass to avoid the traps and keep the Mini Super Pet moving through the next part of the course.

pages.title: Nuclear Day Survival
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Explore a city after a nuclear explosion in Nuclear Day Survival. Scavenge and craft supplies while dealing with hunger, disease, and radiation. Search for missing documents and decide who to help as you look for a way out of the city and try to find your old love.

pages.title: Idle Legend
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Fight monsters to build up battle energy in Idle Legend. Use it to unlock bosses and defeat them for coins, then decide where to spend what you earn. Buy upgrades, skins, or pets as you take on more fights and work through the quests.

pages.title: Relax Mini Games Collection
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Switch between activities in Relax Mini Games Collection. Make ice cream, cook mooncakes, or design a car, depending on what you feel like doing. Follow the steps in one activity and move on to a different one when you’re ready for a change.

pages.title: Pool 8
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Work out the order to sink every ball in Pool 8. Move around the table one step at a time and check which pocket each shot can reach. Plan how the first shot will leave the rest of the table before you commit to it.

pages.title: Roblox Christmas Dressup
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Dress up Roblox-style avatars in Roblox Christmas Dressup. Browse winter clothes, holiday outfits, and accessories, then put together a combination for the celebration. Try a cozy look for one avatar and use more formal pieces for another.

pages.title: Lipstick Collector Run
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Gather lipstick parts while dodging obstacles in Lipstick Collector Run. Complete wraps to unlock marked levels and use your earnings to try new colors. Unlock hands that help with collection, then see how much you can earn on a run with more lipsticks.

pages.title: Stunt Fury
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Take on stunt platforms in Stunt Fury. Build up speed for a launch and watch how the vehicle moves after leaving the ramp. Try different approaches to each platform and work on getting the landing under control.

pages.title: Fat Cat Life
pages.creator: Harbi Games
pages.description: Pick a cat and take on tasks in Fat Cat Life. Earn coins by completing jobs that range from simple to more difficult, then spend them on cats or hats. Try a new combination before heading out to tackle another task.

pages.title: Wheel Transform 3D
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Tap to change the wheel’s shape in Wheel Transform 3D. Watch what’s coming up and transform the wheel in time to get past traps. Keep changing it as the route calls for different moves and try to reach the finish without getting stopped.

pages.title: Tomb of the Mask Online
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Paint every part of a maze in Tomb of the Mask Online. Move from wall to wall and look for any corners you haven’t covered yet. Watch for hazards along the route, then finish painting the layout to unlock the next labyrinth.

pages.title: Spooky Pipes Puzzle
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Connect the pipes across 120 levels in Spooky Pipes Puzzle. Turn pieces to make an uninterrupted network and watch for a witch who can spin the grid or rearrange pipes. Check what moved when she appears and repair the connections before you finish.

pages.title: Scary Halloween: Spooky Nights
pages.creator: Immanitas Ent. GmbH
pages.description: Swap Halloween symbols to make matches in Scary Halloween: Spooky Nights. Check the goal before choosing a move, then look for groups that help you meet it. Keep an eye on the clock while you work through each board, because time can run out before you finish.

pages.title: Children's Day Memory
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Turn over cards and remember the pictures in Children's Day Memory. Match each item with its partner and clear the whole board before time runs out. New symbols and harder layouts give you more positions to remember as you move through the levels.

pages.title: Save The Obby Blox
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Protect a small character from bees in Save The Obby Blox. Pick a shape and position it so it forms a barrier when the bees attack. Try different placements across 20 physics puzzles and see if you can keep the character safe while earning every star.

pages.title: Block Craft Zombie Attack
pages.creator: SarpGames
pages.description: Survive waves of undead enemies in Block Craft Zombie Attack. Earn weapons to help you hold off the next group and fight bosses or rare zombies for better rewards. Build up your level to unlock more maps and take on the waves in a new setting.

pages.title: Pocket ZONE
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Explore the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone in Pocket ZONE. Make choices as you move through hostile territory, look for valuable supplies, and decide when an encounter is worth the risk. Try to survive long enough to build up your resources and reach the nuclear plant.

pages.title: Besties on Wednesday
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Style two roommates for magic school in Besties on Wednesday. Give one student a gothic look with dark clothes and try bright pieces for her roommate. Browse the choices for each girl and put together outfits that reflect their different tastes.

pages.title: Noob VS Evil Granny
pages.creator: danygames.com
pages.description: Search an abandoned house for your missing girlfriend in Noob VS Evil Granny. A letter points you toward the outskirts of the city, where you’ll have to find a way inside and look for her. Keep watch as you explore the house and work toward the rescue.

pages.title: Catch Huggy Wuggy!
pages.creator: Anybody Party
pages.description: Chase Huggy Wuggy through a series of trials in Catch Huggy Wuggy! Get past enemies in your way and prepare for bosses that interrupt the pursuit. Keep up with the chase as the challenges change, and check out the available skins as you play.

pages.title: Dress Up - Games for Girls
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Style 12 princesses in Dress Up - Games for Girls. Choose hairstyles, dresses, gloves, shoes, and extras such as wings, then see how the pieces look together. Try a casual style for one princess and use the more formal options for another.

pages.title: Adorable Girls Valentino Fashion
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Help Willow and her friends get ready for a fashion contest in Adorable Girls Valentino Fashion. Look through the clothes and use the Valentino-inspired theme to guide your choices. Build an outfit for each friend before they show off their looks in the contest.

pages.title: Mahjong
pages.creator: HelloGame
pages.description: Find pairs of identical tiles in Mahjong and connect them to remove them from the board. Look for matches you can clear quickly to build a combo and earn more points. Use each cleared pair to make room for new connections until the board is empty.

pages.title: Sokonumber
pages.creator: Misc.261 Games
pages.description: Move numbered tiles to their marked destinations in Sokonumber. Look at where each tile has to finish before you start moving it, and think about how one move affects the rest of the layout. Put every number in place to open the next puzzle.

pages.title: Kingdom of the Wind
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Command the Wind Warriors in Kingdom of the Wind and defend the last castle for eight days. Keep your forces in the fight as attackers approach, and decide where to focus your defense to protect the castle until the other Wind Tribe arrives.

pages.title: Friends Hippie Trends
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Create hippie-inspired outfits for Emma, Mia, and Ava in Friends Hippie Trends. Browse the clothes and try different combinations as the friends experiment with the style. Give each one her own look while keeping the outfits tied to the same fashion theme.

pages.title: Four Colors Multiplayer Monument Edition
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Match the current card by number or color in Four Colors Multiplayer Monument Edition. Use action cards to disrupt the other players and try to empty your hand first. Face up to three people or computer opponents, and press the 1 button when you’re down to your last card.

pages.title: Zombie Sniper
pages.creator: Mad Buffer
pages.description: Cover civilians and take out zombies in Zombie Sniper. Look for the undead moving toward the survivors, then line up a shot before they get too close. Keep scanning the area for new threats as you help the civilians through the attack.

pages.title: Princess Military Fashion
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Put together military-inspired outfits in Princess Military Fashion. Browse pieces such as khaki jumpsuits and pencil skirts, then combine them to give each character an individual look. Try a new combination when you want a different take on the uniform theme.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Skin Care
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Get Baby Hazel ready for a winter day in Baby Hazel Skin Care. Help her take a warm bath and apply lotion and lip balm before dressing her. Then serve her some warm water and nutritious food so she’s ready to enjoy the snowy weather.

pages.title: Christmas Trucks Memory
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Study the positions of holiday truck pictures in Christmas Trucks Memory before they disappear. Select the spots you remember as quickly as you can once the round begins. Try to take in more of the board during the brief preview as you work through the levels.

pages.title: Cars In The Future Hidden
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Look for hidden stars in futuristic car illustrations in Cars In The Future Hidden. Scan both the vehicles and the scenery, because the faint stars can blend into wheels, bodywork, or buildings. Click each one when you spot it and finish the search before the timer runs out.

pages.title: Snake Fruit
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Steer a snake toward fruit in Snake Fruit. Each piece it eats makes it longer, giving you less room to turn on the next pass. Use the arrows to guide it around the field without crossing its body or going beyond the edge.

pages.title: Space Jet Racing : Space Speed 2020
pages.creator: Flick Gamer
pages.description: Pilot a jet through an endless course in Space Jet Racing : Space Speed 2020. Steer through the route as it gets harder and use boosters along the way. Unlock more jets and take one out on another run to see if you can travel farther.

pages.title: Ludo King Offline
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Roll the die and choose which token to move in Ludo King Offline. Work your pieces around the board and into the home area ahead of your opponents. Think about where each roll can take you before deciding which piece should move.

pages.title: Final Countdown
pages.creator: Enrich Games
pages.description: Push opponents toward the edges in Final Countdown. Move with the arrow keys and look for chances to knock someone off while keeping your own balance. Stay away from the edge when the crowd closes in and try to be the last one on the platform.

pages.title: Adam and Eve GO
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Guide Adam through forests, snowy areas, and underground passages in Adam and Eve GO. Look out for dinosaurs and meet characters such as a mummy along the way. Find the red flower to bring to Eve as you help Adam make it home.

pages.title: Fort Builder
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Build a fort and practice using weapons in Fort Builder. Choose among three kinds of structures and put them together however you want. Try different weapons and projectiles in the space you’ve built, then change the fort’s layout to make another setup.

pages.title: Tripping Balls
pages.creator: OvenBakedGames
pages.description: Read the colors and symbols before pressing a button in Tripping Balls. Use the clues to decide whether to press left, right, or both as each new ball comes up. Follow the rule for the current symbol, because a wrong input can end the run.

pages.title: Rock Paper Scissors
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Look at two opponents’ choices and pick the winner in Rock Paper Scissors. Use the familiar rules to decide which symbol beats the other, then click your answer quickly. You can lose a life if you take too long, so get ready for the next pair.

pages.title: Penguins Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Slide tiles into place in Penguins Slide to put a penguin picture back together. Choose from three pictures and three modes, then follow the outlines and colors to see which pieces belong next to one another. Keep moving the tiles until the picture is complete.

pages.title: Monster Iron Ball
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Aim your shots to clear every red ball in Monster Iron Ball. Blue balls give you extra points, and landing your shot in the basket gives you another ball to use. Look for an angle that reaches the red targets and leaves the ball a path toward the basket.

pages.title: 5 Rex
pages.creator: Bubble Shooter
pages.description: Control five dinosaurs at once in 5 Rex. Watch each runner’s path and make the right dinosaur jump when an obstacle approaches. Keep checking all five routes as the obstacles come up and see how many points you can earn before you miss a jump.

pages.title: Jewel And Santa Claus
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Break jewels to help Santa get home in Jewel And Santa Claus. Look at the obstacles blocking his route and decide what to clear first. Work through 30 levels and find a safe way through each arrangement so he can continue home.

pages.title: Beauty Urban Decay Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild one of three pictures in Beauty Urban Decay Slide. Choose a mode and slide the tiles until neighboring details line up again. Use the edges and colors in the scene to work out where each tile goes before shifting it into place.

pages.title: Friendly Fish Coloring
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Choose from eight fish illustrations in Friendly Fish Coloring. Fill in the fish and the details around them with colors you pick. When you’re done, use the camera button to download the picture and choose another design if you want to try a different palette.

pages.title: Bubble Witch Shooter Magical Saga
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Help a witch save her world in Bubble Witch Shooter Magical Saga. Fire bubbles into matching groups and work through objectives in Mission Mode. Switch to Endless Mode when you want to keep playing and see how long you can hold back the bubbles.

pages.title: FZ Traffic Jam
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Prevent collisions in FZ Traffic Jam by tapping cars to stop or start them. Watch the roads that feed into the crossing and hold one vehicle back while another passes. The traffic gets busier, so look ahead before you send a waiting car through.

pages.title: Extermination of Flies
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Help Jimmy clear his kitchen in Extermination of Flies. Watch for flies as they move into range and take them out before they attack. More flies arrive as the challenge continues, so keep checking the kitchen for the next group while you deal with the ones already there.

pages.title: Street Basketball
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Shoot at moving hoops in Street Basketball. Time your throws so the ball meets the rim as it moves across the screen. Look out for bonus hoops that give you more balls, extra time, or other power-ups to help you keep scoring.

pages.title: Hyper Flappy Bird
pages.creator: Polygon Game Studio
pages.description: Tap to lift the bird through gaps in Hyper Flappy Bird. Let it drop when you need to line up with a lower opening, and stay above the ground. Each pair of pipes you pass earns a point, and you can compare your score on the global rankings.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Summer Fun
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Help Baby Hazel get ready to go out in Baby Hazel Summer Fun. Apply sunscreen and talc as part of her summer routine, then gather the things she needs to take with her. Follow the activities as she prepares to spend time outside in the heat.

pages.title: Bingo Solo
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Play a game of bingo on your own in Bingo Solo. Pick one of three speeds before starting, then follow the numbers as they’re called and mark the ones on your card. Choose a slower pace if you want more time to check each call.

pages.title: Falling Shape
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Rotate the openings in Falling Shape so the piece can pass through. Use A and D or swipe to turn the layout, then line it up with the shape as it drops. Check the outline of the next opening before making another turn.

pages.title: Jelly Pop
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Merge matching jellies in Jelly Pop to make a new one. Check the board before moving so you can bring a pair together and keep room for the next piece. See how far you can build up the jellies before the last space fills.

pages.title: Pick Me Up
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Pick up passengers and deliver them in Pick Me Up. Watch for traffic as you drive between stops, and use openings to move quickly without hitting another car. Get each passenger to their destination before heading out for the next pickup.

pages.title: EG Block Puzzle
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Fit block pieces into a board in EG Block Puzzle. Drag the shapes into the grid and look for an arrangement that covers every square. Work through 240 levels across four difficulty settings, starting with Beginner and building up to Expert.

pages.title: Sack Race
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Solve a math problem to take each step in Sack Race. Read the question and choose the right answer as quickly as you can to move your racer forward. Keep answering to stay ahead of the other racers and be first across the finish line.

pages.title: Circle Runner
pages.creator: Aurora Games
pages.description: Keep a runner circling in Circle Runner. Tap or click to make an obstacle jump, then move underneath it before it lands. Each obstacle you dodge adds to your score, and hitting one ends the run, so watch for the next hurdle as you go around.

pages.title: The Dark One
pages.creator: Tenfor Games
pages.description: Use magic to fight orcs, demons, pirates, and other enemies in The Dark One. Earn gold and experience from battles, then improve your spells and equipment. Keep exploring and growing stronger as you prepare to face the Necromancer and his army.

pages.title: EG Jewelry Comp
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Line up diamonds by color in EG Jewelry Comp. Put each gem on one of the same color to earn points, then get ready for the next one. The game gets faster as you play, so watch the colors closely and react before the pace gets away from you.

pages.title: Flip The Floors
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Move parts of the level to guide a ball in Flip The Floors. Use gears, wheels, slides, and other mechanisms to bring it closer to the exit. Think about where the ball will roll after you move something so it stays balanced and doesn’t fall.

pages.title: OOval
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Guide a character around circles in OOval. Tap to switch between the inside and outside of the orbit and move on to other circles when the paths meet. Time each change to collect gems and see how far you can get.

pages.title: Cute Forest Tavern
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Serve ice cream to animal customers in Cute Forest Tavern. Send each order down the right counter and retrieve the glass after the animal finishes. Some customers need more than others, so keep an eye on each counter and get orders out before anyone loses patience.

pages.title: Mission Terror
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Protect your territory in Mission Terror. Choose a weapon and move into the area held by attackers. Look for an opening to fire as you work through the opposition, and keep track of where the next threat is coming from.

pages.title: Puzzle Brain
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Study the cat faces on the cubes in Puzzle Brain before they disappear. Remember their positions and select the same pattern after the brief preview. Focus on where each face appears so you can find it again once the board is covered.

pages.title: Go Robots 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Get robots through 25 levels in Go Robots 2. Look at the obstacles and work out a route that uses gravity to your advantage. Watch for hostile robots as you guide each one through the layout and move on to the next challenge.

pages.title: Genius Ran
pages.creator: Arwin Margallo
pages.description: Solve the equation shown at the top of the screen in Genius Ran. Compare your result with the answers underneath and select the one that matches. Work out the next problem as soon as it appears and check each calculation before choosing.

pages.title: Aces and Kings Solitaire
pages.creator: Novel Games Limited
pages.description: Use two decks to build eight foundations in Aces and Kings Solitaire. Build some piles up from aces and others down from kings, using rank regardless of suit. Look through the reserve, tableau, and waste for cards that fit the next step on a foundation.

pages.title: Candy Girl Summer Time
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Give a candy-themed doll a makeover in Candy Girl Summer Time. Pick a skin treatment, then choose makeup and an outfit to go with it. Try different combinations and see how changing the clothes affects the look you’ve put together.

pages.title: Cute Yuri on Ice Dress Up
pages.creator: Kawaii Games
pages.description: Choose looks for figure skaters in Cute Yuri on Ice Dress Up. Dress Yuri Katsuki, his coach Victor Nikiforov, or the younger Russian skater Yuri Plisetsky. Explore the options for the other competitors as well and put together a separate outfit for each skater.

pages.title: Late to School Hairstyles
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Help Jenny get ready for her first day in Late to School Hairstyles. Wash her hair with shampoo and a hair mask, then choose a braided style. Pick an outfit to go with it before sending her off to school.

pages.title: Tooth Fairies Princesses
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Choose fairy outfits for three princesses in Tooth Fairies Princesses. Look through the clothes and put together a different style for each character. See how the pieces look together before you finish their outfits for the adventure.
